context: Hiroshi-boss and Ren review on-site operations.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: business ops; field vocabulary (現場/業者/現状/強化/開始) in natural home.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 現場の状況は、どうなっているかね?
lines.en: How are things at the site?
lines.style: measured boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 現状では、人手が足りていません。
lines.en: As it stands, we're short on staff.
lines.style: honest young manager voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 外部の業者に、頼めるかね?
lines.en: Can we ask an outside contractor?
lines.style: thoughtful boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 信頼できる業者に、声をかけています。
lines.en: I'm reaching out to a reliable contractor.
lines.style: measured young manager voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 安全の体制も、強化したい。
lines.en: I also want to strengthen safety measures.
lines.style: firm boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 来週から、点検を強化して開始します。
lines.en: From next week, we'll start stronger inspections.
lines.style: confident young manager voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 現場の声も、よく聞いてくれ。
lines.en: Listen well to the voices on the ground.
lines.style: caring boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 現状を、こまめに報告いたします。
lines.style: reliable young manager voice, soft warm resolved closing throughout
